title: [MTR] MI09 (RER A)
description: MI09 addon for Minecraft Transit Railway.
body:
This addon for Minecraft Transit Railway adds the MI09 (from the RER A line) to the game. It contains the MI09 with its standard RER A livery.

End cars with pantographs are provided with these at either 5-block or 6-block heights for your convenience.
